Avatar Assets/Avatars/Adults/Male_Adult_08; animations m_walk_neutral_01 / m_idle_neutral_01 / m_run_neutral_01 (all_animations_max_motextr_*). Please also cite: Gonzalez-Franco et al., 'The Rocketbox library and the utility of freely available rigged avatars', Frontiers in Virtual Reality 2020.
models.origin: footprint centre on the ground (x/z centred, min y = 0)
models.notes: Realistic rigged human (MIT). Textured with colour + normal maps; *_body = clothes, *_head = head/skin, *_opacity = alpha-tested cards (hair, eyelashes) - for a uniform FSD mannequin look recolour all three but keep alphaTest on *_opacity. Skinned mesh: clone with SkeletonUtils.clone() per instance. Facing +X after normalisation (walk forward = +X).

source_transform.processing: FBX2glTF conversion of the hipoly avatar (81-bone 3ds Max biped, 'Bip01' skeleton); walk/run clips are the motion-extracted (in-place) versions; root (Bip01) horizontal drift removed, only Bip01 keeps translation, all other joints rotation-only; specular maps dropped
